sources.h1: CAST Engineering Gypsy Haze Octave Up Fuzz with Tap Tempo
sources.excerpt: CAST Engineering Gypsy Haze Octave Up Fuzz With Tap Tempo | Delicious Audio Creative Pedals Creative Delay Tape Delay W/ Reverb Delay Distortion Fuzz Overdrive Dual Gain Dirt Boost Compr. + Dynamics Dynamics EQ Filter Wah Filter+EQ Lo-Fi 8 Bit Lo-fi Chorus Flanger Phaser Tremolo Uni-Vibe Modulation Pitch Shifter Octaver pitch Multiverb Reverb Spring Reverb Reverb CV In Granular Synth Pedals Synth Effect Guides Monthly Lists Shopping Guides Coverage Schedule Facebook Stompbox Exhibit CAST Engineering Gypsy Haze Octave Up Fuzz with Tap Tempo Updated Sep. 10, 2018  |  by Paolo De Gregorio The Gypsy Haze by Cast Engineering (check out our profile article on them here ) is an Octave up/fuzz pedal with a very unique switching system for the octave, which also has a “Stutter” mode controllable through Tap Tempo. Here’s the video by The SuperFunAwesomeHappyTime Pedal Show! “We worked countless hours on the tone and simplicity of this pedal. You can find a pallet of awesome tones without having to switch a million switches or turn 100 knobs. Then we added a very unique switching circuit to control the octave modes (on, off and stutter). The last thing we did was to add tap tempo to the stutter mode. All the switching functionality is isolated from the signal path so we retained the signature analog tone the pedal has.
